spec.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import re,collections,json,os
p='inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw'; out=os.environ['OUT']
# CVE-2023-32784-style UTF-16LE sequences: repeated black circles followed by one BMP codepoint
rg=re.compile(rb'((?:\xcf\x25){1,64})(..)',re.S)
counts=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter); examples=[]; sig=bytes.fromhex('03d9a29a67fb4bb5'); sigh=[]
off=0; tail=b''
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 while True:
  b=f.read(32<<20)
  if not b: break
  x=tail+b; base=off-len(tail)
  for m in rg.finditer(x):
   pos=len(m.group(1))//2
   cp=int.from_bytes(m.group(2),'little')
   # keep likely typed password char after at least two bullets; position is zero-based typed index
   if pos>=2 and 0x20<=cp<=0x7e:
    ch=chr(cp); counts[pos][ch]+=1
    if len(examples)<1000: examples.append({'offset':base+m.start(),'position':pos,'char':ch})
  s=0
  while True:
   i=x.find(sig,s)
   if i<0: break
   a=base+i
   if a>=0 and (not sigh or a!=sigh[-1]): sigh.append(a)
   s=i+1
  off+=len(b); tail=x[-132:]
res={'method':'streaming 32MiB chunks; regex repeated UTF-16LE U+25CF followed by printable ASCII UTF-16LE','position_counts':{str(k):dict(v) for k,v in sorted(counts.items())},'examples':examples,'kdbx_signature_offsets':sigh}
with open(out+'/keepass_residue.json','w') as g: json.dump(res,g,indent=2)
print(json.dumps({'position_counts':res['position_counts'],'kdbx_signature_offsets':sigh},indent=2))
PY
